metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API — GRC wrap

components.title: acme-health-intake
components.description: Patient Intake API from cgep-app-starter plus the GRC wrap in this repo: customer CMK, Object Lock evidence vault, CloudTrail, VPC-placed Lambda, and the eight GAPS.md remediations.
components.purpose: Accept patient intake submissions over HTTPS and store ePHI in DynamoDB and S3 under a customer-controlled key, with a pipeline that signs every plan.

control-implementations.description: HIPAA Security Rule safeguards implemented by this wrap. Catalog is a 164.x subset aligned to NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2 (https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/66/r2/final). Evidence objects are written by .github/workflows/grc-gate.yml into s3://acme-health-intake-evidence-a9082633 (COMPLIANCE, 30 days). Replace PENDING in hrefs with the first merged-run receipt after the pipeline has signed.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-01 and GAP-02. Uploads bucket uses aws:kms with alias/acme-health-intake-phi. DynamoDB table intake uses server_side_encryption with the same CMK. Key rotation is enabled.

links.text: Signed grc-gate bundle (plan.json). Fill run id and versionId after the first successful Actions upload.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-03 and GAP-05. Uploads, vault, and trail buckets deny aws:SecureTransport=false. Lambda runs in the starter VPC private subnets with gateway endpoints for S3/DynamoDB and interface endpoints for KMS, logs, SQS, and X-Ray. No second VPC and no NAT.

links.text: Signed grc-gate bundle. Fill after first pipeline run.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-04 and GAP-06. Uploads, vault, and trail buckets have versioning Enabled. DynamoDB has PITR. Lambda has an SQS DLQ and Active X-Ray tracing. Reserved concurrency is not set: this account cannot reserve without dropping UnreservedConcurrentExecution below 10.

links.text: Signed grc-gate bundle. Fill after first pipeline run.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-07. Lambda inline policy allows dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem and s3:PutObject/GetObject on the intake table and uploads prefix only, plus kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey on the PHI CMK.

links.text: Signed grc-gate bundle. Fill after first pipeline run.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-08. HTTP API $default stage writes access logs to /aws/apigateway/acme-health-intake-* and throttles to 10 rps / 20 burst. WAF is out of scope for this sprint. Multi-region CloudTrail with log-file validation records management events.

links.text: Signed grc-gate bundle. Fill after first pipeline run.
